items.headline: SpaceX's AI data-center buildout shows operational cracks ahead of Google's Sept. 30 GPU deadline
items.note: SpaceX must deliver 110,000 Nvidia GPUs to Google by Sept. 30 under its $920M/month xAI compute-lease deal or face proportional payment cuts/termination after a grace period, and reports of cooling/power outages plus a data-center leadership exodus raise real doubt it hits that deadline.
